status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; revised by issues #518 (ADR-0039) and #523 (ADR-0040); read by scripts/contracts/contract.sh and the module's command. Format: docs/records/design-reviews/io-contract-modules.md > 5.
goal: For each pull request it is given, CI's verdict on its head with its ground — green, or, where the target's CI does not run for it, that fact and its ground, never read as green — with, given the build report, the CI job that ran each test file the change added.

timeout.note: the run's bound in seconds; not given, 900. Reaching it ends the run with its failure output

pull_requests.note: the pull requests to confirm: the list at .pull_requests, each {pr: <owner>/<name>#<N>, head}

build_report.note: given, the test files the change added (## Test files kept) and the ci-deferred lint chains, whose CI run the body's CI part states

ci.note: {prs: [{pr: <owner>/<name>#<N>, head, verdict, ground}]} — verdict green, not-run, or what CI showed instead; ground what the verdict rests on. Each pull request's body carries the verdict in its CI part (docs/units/delivery.md > CI)

failure.note: Written instead of the expected output when the run does not reach its goal, or reaches its timeout: what the run did and why it did not reach the goal — an input it needed and was not given named as such. check-out then writes `failed` (docs/units/delivery.md > What both modules owe).
